basic_details.job_title: RMC Additional Chief Fire Officer Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Rajkot Municipal Corporation (RMC) has officially released a notification for the recruitment of 1 Additional Chief Fire Officer Posts. This recruitment drive offers a great opportunity for candidates looking for government jobs. Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the official website.

age_limit.details: Minimum Age: 21 years Maximum Age: 45 years Age Relaxation: 5 years for reserved category candidates of Gujarat origin only. No upper age limit for existing Rajkot Municipal Corporation employees. Maximum age (including relaxations) cannot exceed 45 years except for current RMC employees.

qualification.education_qualification: Bachelor’s degree + Divisional Officers Course or Fire Prevention Course from National Fire Service College, Nagpur OR Direct Fire Engineering/Technology degree (B.E./B.Tech (Fire), B.E./B.Tech (Fire & Safety), B.Sc. (Fire), etc.), Minimum 8 years experience in Fire Brigade field, at least 5 years in Station Officer / Assistant Divisional Fire Officer level or higher, Valid Heavy Motor Vehicle driving licence, Basic computer knowledge (Gujarat Civil Services Rules 1967), Adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi or both, Physical Standards: Male - Height 165 cm, Chest 81-86 cm, Weight 50 kg; Female - Height 157 cm, Weight 46 kg (relaxations for ST)
qualification.details: Additional Chief Fire Officer: Bachelor’s degree from a recognized university + Divisional Officers Course or Fire Prevention Course from National Fire Service College, Nagpur OR B.E./B.Tech (Fire)/B.Tech (Fire & Safety)/B.Sc. selection_process: Shortlisting based on application data / merit Written test / Online test (depending on number of applicants) Physical test Interview / Document verification
how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the RMC Additional Chief Fire Officer Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 19-11-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of RMC to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RMC Additional Chief Fire Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the RMC Additional Chief Fire Officer post is 19 November 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum educational qualification required for the Additional Chief Fire Officer post?
faq.answer: A Bachelor’s degree from a recognized university is the minimum educational qualification, along with specific courses or a direct degree in Fire Engineering/Technology. Please refer to the detailed eligibility criteria for complete information.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to this position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Additional Chief Fire Officer post is between 21 years and 45 years. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories and existing RMC employees.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Additional Chief Fire Officer post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Additional Chief Fire Officer in the Rajkot Municipal Corporation recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Additional Chief Fire Officer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary in the pay scale of Rs. ₹56,100 to ₹1,77,500 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for General category candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category candidates is ₹500/-. SC/ST and Women candidates have a reduced fee of ₹250/-.

faq.question: Q7. What are the physical standards required for male candidates?
faq.answer: Male candidates must meet the physical standards of Height: 165 cm, Chest: 81-86 cm, and Weight: 50 kg. Relaxations may apply for ST candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the RMC Additional Chief Fire Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves shortlisting, a written or online test, a physical test, and an interview followed by document verification.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any experience required for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, a minimum of 8 years of experience in the Fire Brigade field is required, with at least 5 years at the Station Officer/Assistant Divisional Fire Officer level or higher.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is highly recommended to read it thoroughly before applying.
